Ammaji advises Angoori to humiliate Bhoorey as part of a ritual. Later, when Bhoorey arrives at the house, Tiwari and Angoori berate him.
Angoori gives Bhoorey some onion roti to eat. Later, she and Tiwari ask him to sleep outside on the lawn for the night.
Vibhuti files a complaint against Tiwari at an NGO run by Teeka and his friends. But, when they visit Tiwari's house, both he and Angoori deny the accusations of harassing Bhoorey.
Vibhuti Narayan Mishra and Manmohan Tiwari live in the same neighbourhood in Kanpur. They both try to impress each other's wives but end up landing in peculiar situations.
Vibhuti tells Angoori about Santa Claus, prompting her to ask for a car. After Vibhuti gifts her a toy car while dressed as Santa, the entire Modern Colony celebrates Christmas together.
Tiwari accidentally hits Vibhuti with his scooter outside his house. Later, Vibhuti's mother, Helen, instigates him to sue Tiwari for hurting him and file for damages.
Tiwari feels pity for Vibhuti until a lawyer informs him of a lawsuit worth INR 5 crore filed by Vibhuti. Later, Tiwari accepts Vibhuti's conditions to avoid paying the claim.

Vibhuti endures the pain of the examination until his lawyer and Tiwari successfully force him to confess the truth. Later, the residents of Modern Colony come together to celebrate the New Year.
Tiwari scolds Angoori due to financial stress, prompting Anita to intervene. Meanwhile, Vibhuti suffers a loss of INR 1.5 lakh and plans to make up for it.
Vibhuti disguises himself as a woman to help Tiwari with a superstitious remedy. Later, Teeka and his friends use Vibhuti's plan to scam Tiwari by posing as police officers.
Tiwari requests Vibhuti to persuade a woman to meet him once more while Vibhuti offers Angoori a gift. Meanwhile, Anita joins hands with Happu to catch the thieves roaming the town.

While Rajjo and Amma keep arguing, Malaika gives valuable advice to Happu. Later, a clever Malaika blackmails a clueless Kat.
Vibhuti sabotages Manmohan's fake kung fu practice, causing him to feel bad. Later, Anita asks Manmohan to destroy an electrical appliance using his techniques.
Manmohan accuses Vibhuti of fraud despite Anita's excitement over his interview. Later, Saxena rescues Vibhuti after goons kidnap him for his secret formula and a vendor exposes his lies.
Manmohan, stressed and constipated, hides his condition from Anita, but Angoori exposes the truth. Vibhuti seizes the moment, feeding Angoori a flawed remedy with hidden intent, then mocks Manmohan.
Angoori entices Manmohan, yet he rejects her advances due to his severe discomfort.
Manmohan lashes out at Teeka after relentless taunts, fueled by Malkhan, over his constipation. Vibhuti provokes Teeka into filing an FIR against Manmohan, with Happu Singh's backing.
Manmohan refuses to unblock the shared water supply, but Saxena identifies a pipeline.
After a fight with Vibhuti, Manmohan falsely claims Prem was in an accident and tricks Vibhuti into taking Happu Singh's car. Manmohan and Happu then secretly steal it, framing Vibhuti.
Tiwari and Vibhuti irritate their wives by comparing them to a famous actress. Meanwhile, Anita and Angoori decide to retaliate by playing various pranks on their husbands.
Anita traps Happu Singh by sticking him to a chair with adhesive. The Commissioner fumes at his incompetence. To provoke Vibhuti, Angoori falsely claims Masterji harassed her.
Vibhuti Narayan Mishra and Manmohan Tiwari live in the same neighbourhood in Kanpur. They both try to impress each other's wives but end up landing in peculiar situations.
Vibhuti and Manmohan attempt to move Happu Singh's body but run into the commissioner. They bluff their way through, retrieving the body. Anita and Angoori uncover the duo's scheme to torment them.
David is drawn to a veiled woman, only to discover she is Happu Singh. Thought dead, he is taken away in a rickshaw until his shoes reveal the truth and he comes around.
Vibhuti and Manmohan's drinking session devolves into a heated dispute. Consequently, Anita and Angoori's attempts to restore peace between them prove futile.
Vibhuti and Manmohan ridicule the boundary established by Anita and Angoori, who pretend to be enemies to test their husbands. The men feel anxious as the wives feign intense hostility.
Tillu and Tika form a gang while Saxena, Prem and Malkhan form a rival group to represent Anita and Angoori. Later, Anita and Angoori reveal their rivalry was a ruse to teach a lesson.
Vibhuti and Manmohan find out about Anita and Angoori's plot to bring them together. Later, Anita reaches out to Jagdishwar Mishra for help.
Ammaji informs Manmohan and Angoori about a life-threatening prediction from Pandit Ramphal. Subsequently, she instructs the couple to laugh constantly as a protective measure.
An anthology of passionate love stories backed with strong emotions and supernatural elements, set in different backdrops.

Hanuman grows to become an ardent devotee of Lord Rama and plays a pivotal role in helping him fight the evil king, Ravana.

Believing that fostering Teeka brings immense wealth, Manmohan and Vibhuti shower him with grand hospitality. Later, Tillu and Malkhan expose his lie, prompting the duo to punish him.
Radha strives to overcome various challenges in order to save her marriage, along with tackling betrayal and promises which test her resilience.
